scope_choices: This is automated model review, not independent human verification or replication. This synthesis directly received complete text and earlier automated image-review notes, not images.

All physical pages 1–10, including references, the responsible-use statement and Appendices A–D, are present in the assembled review package. Earlier chunk-local statements that other pages were unavailable do not describe this complete package.
The supplied source hash, path, page count and earlier API receipts were not independently recomputed or opened in this pass.
No executable schema validation, semantic preflight, regression tests, graph assembly, filesystem saving or canonical admission was performed here.

The exact checkpoint revision, original training losses, database release and patient-level development/test partition controls remain insufficiently reported. No capabilities are imported solely from reference [27].

Functional L3 here means matched one-step alternative-action prediction comparison. One-step fidelity and G02 remain unresolved, and neither causal treatment truth nor clinical benefit is established.

R2 is limited to the source-reported internal sensitivity audit on actual retrospective clinical records designated the frozen checkpoint's test split. It does not certify predictive accuracy, independent split verification or clinical counterfactual correctness.

The clinical one-hour prediction extent, 24-hour history and 5,000 statistical bootstrap resamples are distinct quantities. No recursive rollout, effective validated horizon or closed-loop policy control is shown.
Figure 1 and Section 3 leave treatment/state indexing insufficiently precise. No information-availability leakage pass is claimed.

Co-occurrence ratios establish one-way component-to-intervention containment in the audited sample, not mutual co-occurrence, numerical-value support, structural population zeros or a universal prohibition on partial setting changes. Containment of category-defining vasoactive agents is partly definitional.
The audit is explicitly of the test split; the introduction's training-support language is not established by the reported analysis.
The final limitation states that single-setting configurations occur and the experiment tests granularity rather than empirical support, qualifying the stronger unsupported-component framing.
Donor configurations and high embedding similarity do not establish recipient-conditioned support, clinical appropriateness, exchangeability or contraindication compliance.
The text-level replacement rule is described, but the clinical meaning of omitted ventilator fields, including inheritance versus unknown status, is not fully resolved.
Different-stay matching does not prove different-patient matching. The relationship between 1,130 eligible reference onsets and 1,089 eligible targets is insufficiently explained.
The 52.6% all-five reference-bundle figure and 338 ventilator-mode comparisons remain unreconciled. Both reported values are retained without an invented correction.
Eligibility uses subsequent stay duration and ventilation persistence, limiting correspondence with real-time decision populations.

Repeated targets within stays, reused references and possibly repeated pooled comparison rows complicate target-level bootstrap uncertainty. Cluster-aware analyses and pooled weighting details are not reported.
Linear/quadratic adjustment for d_a does not exclude text length, documentation density, embedding direction, interactions or regression misspecification as alternative explanations.
Setting-specific means use different overlapping subsets. Larger bundle response is reported for 70.6–89.5% of pairs across settings, not every target.

No latent-to-clinical relevance threshold, predictive calibration, uncertainty decomposition, external transfer, actual expert evaluation or prospective benefit is established. Subgroup-response analysis is explicitly unperformed.
De-identification and DUA use are source-reported; ethics approval, regulatory compliance/authorization and operational safety controls are not thereby established.
Appendix D refers to a plot, but upstream image notes report no separately displayed plot on physical page 10. Figure 2(b), on page 4, is the visible response-versus-edit plot.
All legacy cells are historical values preserved unchanged, including their earlier claims about review scope and quotation matching. Those metadata are not new verification claims by this pass.
